components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action button for primary submissions and start triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #fafafa; color: #18181b; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e4e4e7; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subtle interactive action button for secondary commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #27272a; color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Study Deck Card
components.description: Vocabulary group container with level badge and meta count.
components.html:
B215 Words
Advanced Business Idioms
components.css: .ds-card { background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(0.98); background: #1f1f23; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-badge { background: #27272a; color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-meta { color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 13px; } .ds-card-title { color: #fafafa; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Quiz Option Tile
components.description: Tactile multiple choice tile used during active study quizzes.
components.css: .ds-quiz-option { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #18181b; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-quiz-option:hover { border-color: #3f3f46; background: #1f1f23; } .ds-quiz-key { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #27272a; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-quiz-text { font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: Wordingo strips away AI visual clichés in favor of a quiet, purposeful monochrome atmosphere. Surfaces step through zinc tones (#09090b -> #18181b -> #27272a) and color is restricted solely to learning state feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome foundation in deep zinc tones
Tactile 12-16px rounded corners with springy active presses
Strict functional color accenting (Emerald/Rose for quiz results)

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Color accents exist only to inform (correct/wrong/status), never to decorate. No gradient or neon cards.

rules.name: The Tonal Stepping Rule
rules.body: Depth is created by moving up the zinc scale (#09090b canvas -> #18181b card -> #27272a interactive), not soft drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain a minimum 44px touch height for all interactive elements.
Do use tonal progression to indicate elevation.
Do keep questions and options high-contrast and distraction-free.
donts: Don't introduce purple-to-cyan gradient cards or glowing decorative borders.
Don't nest cards inside cards with redundant strokes.
Don't use input font sizes smaller than 16px on mobile.
